guides.title: Find your next career path with Claude + Scout
guides.blurb: By the end, you'll have 2 to 3 realistic next roles, the evidence from your own experience for each, and a clear list of gaps to close.
inside: Have Scout do it for you
guides.intro: You don't know what job to go for, so you apply to everything. That feels like effort, but it backfires. Scattered searches look unfocused to recruiters. A short list of roles you can back up with real evidence gives you a direction, and direction is what makes your applications read as intentional.

free.title: Step 1: Dump your experience (5 minutes)
free.body:
You can do this with any AI chat, ChatGPT or Claude. No Scout needed.

Open a new chat. Paste your resume, or write out your last 2 to 3 jobs, side gigs included. Side hustles count. They show real skills.

free.title: Step 2: List what you actually do
free.prompt:
Here is my work history: [paste your resume or job list]

Read it and list the 8 to 10 skills and strengths I have shown most clearly. For each one, point to the specific job or task that proves it. Do not guess. Only use what I wrote.

free.title: Step 3: Find adjacent roles
free.prompt:
Based on those skills, which roles fit my experience that I haven't considered? Give me 2 to 3 roles that sit next to what I already do. For each role, tell me:
1. Why it fits, using evidence from my work history
2. What is missing or thin in my background for that role

Keep it plain and specific. Do not tell me what any role pays.

free.title: Step 4: Pressure-test the gaps
free.body: Pick the role that interests you most and paste this:
free.prompt: For the role [role name], list the 3 biggest gaps between my background and what employers usually ask for. For each gap, suggest one small thing I could do in the next 30 days to start closing it, such as a project, a course, or a side gig.

locked.title: Step 5: Pick one direction
locked.body: Choose the role that feels most doable, not just the most exciting. Write one sentence: "I'm going for ____ roles." Use that sentence to filter every job post you open this week.

locked.title: Step 6: Check the AI's work
locked.body: Look at the evidence it gave you. Does it match what you really did? Fix anything that's off and ask it to try again.

locked.title: Step 7: Have Scout do it for you
locked.body:
Scout works from your CareerID, so the evidence for each role comes from your actual background.

1. Add Scout to Claude on your computer with this link: https://scoutjob.ai/start?app=claude&ref=sidehustlecareers-hub&utm_source=sidehustlecareers&utm_medium=creator-hub&utm_campaign=find-your-next-career-path&utm_content=elena

2. Open a new chat and paste this prompt:

3. What you'll see: Scout's path check. That means 2 to 3 adjacent roles, the evidence for each from your CareerID, and the gap for each.

Trial note: The trial includes 1 path check. After that, Scout is $47/mo. Use your one check on a real question, and have your target in mind before you run it.
locked.prompt: Scout, which roles fit my experience that I haven't considered?

guides.tip:
Your side hustle is proof, so use it. Did you sell on Etsy, drive for a delivery app, run social media for a friend's shop, or tutor on weekends? Put it in your work history in Step 1 as a real job. Write what you did, who you did it for, and what changed because of it. Those details often point to roles you'd never search for on your own.

Then pick one gap from your list and start closing it this week. Work smarter. Live bigger.
